name: list_gateways
description: List the scopes device tools accept as gateway_id: first 'world', every device in the world (status 'bypass', kept for older clients), then every StationGod Gateway in the loaded world with its availability and network status; a gateway id only narrows a call to that gateway's data networks. status is bypass (world), ready (available true: its id scopes a call), incomplete (not fully built) or no_data_network (no data cable on either port); a device tool given an unavailable gateway answers gateway_unavailable naming that status, an unknown id gateway_not_found. bypass_gateway is always true, kept for older clients.
